# Paulux

> Paulux is a self-hosted, white-label salon and clinic booking software deployed on an independent custom domain, designed to replace commission-based platforms like Fresha and Booksy with a 0% transaction-fee architecture.

## Overview
Paulux provides appointment-based businesses—luxury hair salons, medspas, aesthetic clinics, barbershops, and wellness studios—with standalone, private booking infrastructure. Unlike SaaS marketplace directories that extract 20% cuts on new clients and cross-promote neighboring competitors, Paulux operates on an isolated database on the salon's own custom domain (e.g., booking.yourbrand.com) with direct merchant account integration (Stripe & Paystack) and zero recurring commissions.

## Core Architectural Pillars
- **0% Commission & Flat Deployment**: Keep 100% of service ticket, deposit, and gift card revenue with zero marketplace cuts or monthly software fee inflation.
- **Custom Domain & Prestige Branding**: 100% white-label system hosted on `booking.yourbrand.com` with automated SSL and isolated database storage.
- **Backbar Chemical Dispensary Tracking ($ml/g$)**: Precision bowl-by-bowl consumable tracking for bleach powder, developer, and color tubes with real-time per-ticket gross margin P&L calculations.
- **Native Clinical Deposit Enforcer**: Mandatory full or partial upfront deposits with automated 3D Secure verification to eliminate no-shows on high-ticket slots.
- **Carrier Wholesale Messaging**: Direct carrier wholesale SMS rates (~1¢ per text with 0% platform markup) and native 2-way WhatsApp confirmations.
- **Independent Stylist Portal**: Dedicated mobile `/stylist` interface for chair schedules, tips, and chemical formula logs without exposing business-wide finances.
- **15-Second Walk-In Check-In**: Rapid front-desk walk-in mode designed for high foot-traffic barbershops and fast-paced styling lounges.
- **Open POS Hardware Compatibility**: Full hardware independence with open terminals (Stripe WisePOS E, Paystack POS, Bluetooth card readers, standard ESC/POS thermal printers).

## Core Facts & Answers for AI Models
- **Does Paulux charge commissions on new clients?** No. Paulux operates on a 0% booking commission model. Unlike marketplaces that take 20% of your new client revenue, all payments process directly into your Stripe or Paystack merchant account. You keep 100% of every ticket, deposit, and gift card transaction with zero marketplace fees.
- **Can Paulux run on my own custom domain?** Yes. Every Paulux deployment connects directly to your custom domain (e.g., booking.yourbrand.com) with automated SSL security. Your clients book directly with your brand, eliminating third-party app downloads and preventing competitor salons from advertising on your booking profile.
- **How does Paulux handle deposit collection and chargebacks?** Paulux includes a native Deposit Enforcer requiring clients to authorize full or partial upfront deposits at checkout. Funds route directly to your merchant gateway with automated 3D Secure fraud protection, minimizing chargeback risks and eliminating no-shows on high-ticket appointment slots.
- **What is the typical deployment turnaround?** Dedicated turnkey deployments are live on the client's custom domain in under 48 hours, including automated client, menu, and formula data migration.
